(i) the changeability of a production system can be assessed based on a set of change drivers, (ii) the changeability can be improved by the application of a set of improvement measures.

the identification and assessment of change drivers and change scenarios are a crucial success factor for competitive manufacturing companies in a dynamic market environment.

a comprehensive understanding of the changeability of manufacturing enterprises in the context of the sociotechnical production system.
the identification of change drivers, the assessment of change scenarios and the evaluation of the benefit of different scenarios.
the identification and assessment of change drivers and the evaluation of different change scenarios for production systems.
